The purchases of marketable securities represented 100% of the total net cash used in investing activities in 2023, as the only cash used in investing activities was attributed to these purchases.

The filing does not provide the percentage of total gross unrealized losses that the total fair value represented. The data includes gross unrealized losses and fair value, but no calculation or statement of what percentage the fair value represents relative to the gross unrealized losses.
